facts.overview: When a prisoner transfer van is attacked, the cop in charge must fight those inside and outside while dealing with a silent foe: the icy temperatures.
facts.title: Below Zero

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Cut off in the freezing dark with threats on both sides of the reinforced steel, who orchestrates the assault, and who will outlast the night?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: During a routine transport in Spain, an armored prisoner van is ambushed on a desolate road. Trapped with volatile inmates, the officer in charge must fend off external assailants while surviving sub-zero cold.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast, suspenseful, and frostbitten, pairing intense multi-sided danger with engaged, high-tension energy ideal for solo or group viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Lluís Quílez delivers a relentless, pressure-cooker Spanish thriller where ruthless human hostility collides with brutal freezing elements in a fast-paced battle for survival.
